old_problem: The suite body did not prove which CUDA driver library DCGM loaded or that the CUDA Main Library check ran; service order was inverted and level-1 evidence conflicted with the required level 4.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 CUDA main-library loading validation
test_case.purpose: Verify DCGM loads the approved CUDA driver library for all selected GPUs and that the named software check plus every applicable level-4 test completes without hidden skip or initialization fault.
required_package: Isolation window and health abort limits
test_case.test_command: Capture GPU, driver, CUDA library resolution and initialization baselines; establish the approved DCGM service state, change persistence only with approval, run one full untruncated level-4 diagnostic, record the CUDA Main Library software result and all tests/skips, then restore baselines.
test_case.expected_result: The intended CUDA driver library resolves and initializes every selected GPU, the CUDA Main Library check passes without cannot-open/API error, and all expected level-4 tests pass with no unexplained skip.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires library provenance, the named CUDA check and complete suite accounting; a generic suite status, device list, level-1-only output or truncated tail is insufficient.
safety_gate: Approved extended diagnostic and runtime-state changes
Drain selected GPUs and retain OOB access
Do not alter library paths during validation
Monitor thermal/power/XID/AER/host health and stop without retry
expected_evidence: Named CUDA check and error/skip ledger
test_case.recovery: On fault, abort the diagnostic, restore original service/persistence state, confirm CUDA device initialization and GPU health, preserve the failed result, and do not rerun automatically.
